{
  "problem_statement": "Within the supplied simulation, kiln bookings experience recurring delays: two independently authored logs each record four delayed bookings out of twenty over matching stated weeks using the same delay definition (C1). Disjoint booking identifiers and independent recording support corroboration within this bounded scope; no material contrary observation is supplied (C2). The observed need is well supported within the simulation, but causes, broader prevalence and intervention benefit remain untested (C3). This does not establish real-world need or customer validation.",
  "affected_users": "Simulated kiln-booking participants whose bookings are delayed; participant roles, numbers of unique people and downstream impacts are not specified (C1).",
  "observable_problem": "Each of two independent simulated logs records 4 delayed bookings among 20 bookings over matching stated weeks, with a shared delay definition (C1, C2).",
  "urgency": {
    "frequency": "4 of 20 bookings (20%) in each log during matching stated weeks; exact dates and recurrence beyond those windows are not provided (C1, C2).",
    "severity": "unknown",
    "claim_refs": [
      "C1",
      "C2",
      "C3"
    ]
  },
  "workarounds": [],
  "alternatives": [],
  "software_hypothesis": null,
  "cross_field": null,
  "cross_field_absent_reason": "No supplied claim supports a transferable mechanism between evidence assessment and community operations. Corroborated delay counts establish an observed pattern, not an intervention mechanism (C1–C3).",
  "evidence_strength": "well_supported",
  "gaps": [
    "All observations are author-created synthetic statements. Independent origins are stipulated within the simulation, not independently verified real-world sources (C1, C2).",
    "Only supplied statements are accessible, not underlying booking records. Exact dates and the operational delay threshold are not reproduced, although matching windows and definitions are asserted (C1, C2).",
    "Delay duration, consequences, participant priorities and acceptable delay rates are unknown; severity cannot be assessed (C1–C3).",
    "Causes and wider generalization remain untested. No material contrary observation is supplied within the bounded simulation (C2, C3).",
    "No actual workaround, existing tool or alternative is described. Claim-role labels do not establish these facts; no catalog evidence or external search is available.",
    "No software benefit or cross-field intervention mechanism is supported. Defer intervention selection pending causal evidence and comparison with existing tools, operational changes and human review (C3).",
    "Delayed bookings divided by total bookings is an available baseline measure, not a measured intervention outcome. No tests or customer validation are supplied (C1, C3)."
  ]
}

{
  "problem_statement": "Historical ferry boarding queueing is described only under a retired procedure (C1). The replacement procedure has no current queue observations, so a recurring present-day problem cannot be established (C2). Defer intervention selection pending current observations; the supplied simulation does not establish real-world need or benefit.",
  "affected_users": "Simulated ferry boarding participants under the retired procedure; who, if anyone, experiences queueing under the replacement procedure is unknown (C1, C2).",
  "observable_problem": "Queueing was reported under the retired boarding procedure, but current queue occurrence, duration and recurrence are unobserved (C1, C2).",
  "urgency": {
    "frequency": "Unknown for the replacement procedure; the obsolete report cannot establish current frequency (C1, C2).",
    "severity": "unknown",
    "claim_refs": ["C1", "C2"]
  },
  "workarounds": [],
  "alternatives": [
    {
      "description": "Defer software selection. If separately authorized, obtain current boarding observations under the replacement procedure before deciding whether operational changes or tools are needed.",
      "claim_refs": ["C1", "C2"]
    }
  ],
  "software_hypothesis": null,
  "cross_field": null,
  "cross_field_absent_reason": "C1 and C2 provide no supported transferable mechanism between evidence assessment and community operations; they establish only that historical evidence cannot characterize the replacement procedure.",
  "evidence_strength": "insufficient",
  "gaps": [
    "C1 and C2 are author-created synthetic statements, not retrieved sources or real-world validation; independent corroboration is not established.",
    "Both claims require rechecking and have stale supporting passages. No usable current observation supports a recurring need.",
    "Current affected users, queue frequency, waiting duration and severity are unknown; historical queueing cannot be generalized across the procedure change (C1, C2).",
    "No current workarounds, existing tool capabilities or tool gaps are documented. The replacement procedure is not evidence of improvement or failure (C2).",
    "Only supplied statements are accessible; no catalog alternatives or external search evidence are available.",
    "A future assessment could measure queue occurrence per boarding session and waiting duration, but neither baseline nor results are supplied. Current observations could change the deferral recommendation."
  ]
}

{
  "problem_statement": "Within the author-created simulation, a tool library reports checkout tokens being returned to the wrong hooks (C1). This is a plausible identification or destination-matching problem, but its cause, recurrence rate and operational consequences are unknown. The single-author evidence supports exploration, not an independently corroborated need or a software recommendation.",
  "affected_users": "Simulated tool-library participants returning checkout tokens; staff involvement or burden is not measured (C1).",
  "observable_problem": "Checkout tokens are returned to hooks other than their intended destinations (C1); no error count or total number of returns is supplied.",
  "urgency": {
    "frequency": "Multiple observations are reported, but neither counts, observation period nor return volume is supplied; recurrence rate is unknown (C1).",
    "severity": "unknown",
    "claim_refs": ["C1"]
  },
  "workarounds": [],
  "alternatives": [
    {
      "description": "Consider a non-software paired-label procedure: put matching visible identifiers on checkout tokens and their intended hooks. This adapts the luggage procedure, not a documented tool-library workaround or validated solution.",
      "claim_refs": ["C1", "C2"]
    }
  ],
  "software_hypothesis": null,
  "cross_field": {
    "from_field": "luggage identification",
    "to_field": "tool returns",
    "transferred_mechanism": "Transfer visible paired identifiers and destination matching: give each checkout token and its intended hook the same visible identifier so a participant can match the pair before returning the token (C2).",
    "why_it_transfers": "Both procedures involve matching an identified item to a designated destination. This could help if ambiguous identification contributes to wrong-hook returns, but the cause is unknown and the transfer has not been tested (C1, C2).",
    "claim_refs": ["C1", "C2"]
  },
  "cross_field_absent_reason": null,
  "evidence_strength": "exploratory",
  "gaps": [
    "All evidence is author-created and synthetic; it establishes no real-world need, customer validation or benefit. Single-author observations do not provide independent corroboration (C1, C2).",
    "Counts, observation duration, return volume and operational consequences are absent; frequency and severity cannot be established (C1).",
    "The cause of misplaced tokens is unknown. Paired identifiers may not address the actual cause, and transfer effectiveness remains untested (C2).",
    "No current tool-library workaround, existing-tool assessment or catalog alternative is supplied. Available evidence cannot establish a gap requiring software.",
    "Only supplied synthetic statements are accessible; no return-level dataset is supplied. A future permitted assessment could measure wrong-hook returns divided by total returns, but no baseline exists.",
    "Defer software recommendation. Further investigation would need observed return context, current labeling practices and error counts to distinguish an identification problem from other causes."
  ]
}
